The telescoping quadratic expansion gives \(B=-Q/[\rho(1-\rho)]\), and a separate scalar calculation gives diagonal two-step rate \(1/4\). The standalone exact rational checker verifies four key coefficient identities and finite trajectories; it does not replace the analytic global argument.
